supersedes.reason: V2 completed 27 calls but all responses were truncated by default thinking under maxOutputTokens=400. V3 uses output budget 1200 and an exact-model-supported low thinking level, validated by a neutral JSON schema smoke test. V2 failures remain separately accounted and are not pooled.

scope: A small exploratory comparison of evidence synthesis and action selection across one serial analyst, three isolated specialists, and the same three specialists exchanging pinned notes.
claim_limit: This pilot cannot establish a scaling law or general agent superiority. Task A's source states the core facts; the pilot measures evidence synthesis and verification, not discovery. All actor roles are fresh stateless calls to the same pinned model; role prompts do not establish cognitive independence or distinct-worker effects.

privacy.model_inputs: The public input packet only. It contains open-access paper facts and deterministic arithmetic/unit outputs.
privacy.credential_handling: Read only GEMINI_API_KEY from the existing mode-0600 Gemini env file; send it only in x-goog-api-key header; never put it in a URL, argv, prompt, log, or artifact.

model_selection.provider_route: Google Generative Language API v1beta models/gemini-3.8-flash:generateContent; exact model ID pinned
model_selection.selection_reason: The authenticated Google model list returned models/gemini-3.8-flash with generateContent support, 1,048,576 input tokens, and 65,536 output tokens. Exact-model behavior was tested with neutral schema calls: thinkingLevel=minimal is rejected; thinkingLevel=low is accepted. V3 therefore uses low thinking and maxOutputTokens=1200, retaining the same model and science tasks. USD pricing/actual charge are unknown because no billing meter is available. V2 failure receipts remain separate.
model_selection.cost_basis: Actual USD spend unavailable; do not report zero. Bounded request usage: 27 calls maximum, each with a 9,600-token input limit and 400-token output limit, for at most 270,000 configured input+output tokens. Provider usageMetadata is retained per call.

single_serial_analyst.actor_identity: same stateless analyst role across three sequential calls
single_serial_analyst.communication: The analyst may see its own prior pinned JSON response in calls 2 and 3.

isolated_specialists.actor_identity: three fresh stateless role prompts to the same pinned model; no persistent session or distinct-model claim
isolated_specialists.communication: Each specialist receives the full public input packet and the same tools, but no other specialist's response.

collaborating_specialists.actor_identity: three fresh stateless role prompts to the same pinned model; no persistent session or distinct-model claim
collaborating_specialists.communication: Specialist 2 receives specialist 1's SHA-pinned JSON; specialist 3 receives the exact SHA-pinned JSON from specialists 1 and 2. The actor chooses the next action in each response. This sequential exchange is the communication treatment.

matched_budget_and_access.same_inputs_and_tools: Every actor receives the identical full public packet and identical calculator/unit-algebra results. No source information is withheld from any condition. Peer/self artifacts are the only information difference in the communication treatment; their tokens count toward the same input ceiling. The runner rejects any rendered user prompt above 9,000 UTF-8 bytes before sending and requests maxOutputTokens=1200 with thinkingLevel=low; provider input/output token usage is retained, and any reported usage above its per-call ceiling is a protocol deviation.
matched_budget_and_access.condition_label: Condition IDs are stored with results but omitted from model prompts. Isolated and collaborating specialist roles and turn numbers are identical; the only prompt difference is whether prior response artifacts are included.
matched_budget_and_access.tooling: Two precomputed, deterministic tools in the packet: calculator-v1 and unit-algebra-v1. No web or other model calls are allowed during the pilot.
matched_budget_and_access.execution: Serial calls; no retries, repair calls, or extra adjudication calls. A failed or malformed response consumes its scheduled slot and scores zero. The runner enforces a 9,000-byte rendered-prompt ceiling, requests at most 1,200 output tokens at thinkingLevel=low, reserves 10,800 tokens per call and 291,600 total. USD spend is unknown because no billing meter is available.

aggregation.numeric_fields: median of valid replies; missing if no valid reply
aggregation.boolean_and_categorical_fields: strict majority; ties or fewer than two valid replies yield null
aggregation.primary_comparison: mean deterministic rubric score of the field-wise aggregate per replicate, then mean across three replicates
secondary: number of prior response hashes actually passed to later calls
actual input/output/total tokens; USD charge unknown

scoring.scoring_method: Deterministic parser and exact-value/tolerance checks only. No text grading, model judge, or self-reported confidence.

outcome_reporting: report every scheduled response, including errors and malformed JSON
report per-request token usage; USD spend is unknown
do not claim statistical significance from three repeats
do not infer biological discovery or general scaling from this pilot
separation: V2 is a protocol-failure null run. V3 responses and scores must be analyzed separately; do not pool v2 and v3 scientific outcomes.
